''See also: [[Frozen Blade Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Frozen Blade school]] is a powerful sect headquartered in a snowy region characterized by jagged, razor-sharp ice formations infused with [[sword aura]]. The school manages vast territories, providing protection to entire nations against external invaders and harsh environmental conditions. Its domain is extremely dangerous; the presence of intense aura makes it a location unsuitable for most [[Golds]], as only [[Truegold|Truegolds]] following the [[Path of the Frozen Blade]] possess the necessary strength to survive there. The sect is led by the [[Winter Sage]], also known as [[Min Shuei]] or the [[Sage]] of the Frozen Blade. She is a woman with long white hair and tanned skin who maintains the appearance of a young woman. As one of three [[Sages]] of her generation to manifest the [[Sword Icon]], she is a formidable combatant capable of utilizing massive forged swords and specialized techniques that can freeze entire environments. Her mastery includes the ability to manipulate [[Frozen Blade madra]], which can lock opponents in place and create blizzard-like conditions filled with cutting shards of ice. The [[Winter Sage]] is known for her dedication to her sect, and it is considered unlikely that she would ever abandon it.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Sage]] of the Frozen Blade is a figure known to [[Yerin]], having provided her with a basic language [[construct]] during the [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned King tournament]]. Additionally, the [[Silent King]] is noted for reinforcing his technique upon the [[Sage]] of the Frozen Blade.}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The [[Frozen Blade school]] operates as a vassal faction under the [[Akura clan]], with its team expected to be retrieved in about eight months.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c4">''Uncrowned'', chapter 4</ref> [[Yerin]] is familiar with the [[Sage]] of the Frozen Blade, a figure also known as the [[Winter Sage]] who possesses a sword mounted against a wall.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c4" /> While the Frozen Blade students are ranked in the thirties and have appeared in the arena, only one competitor from the school successfully advanced past the second round.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c12">''Uncrowned'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15">''Uncrowned'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c21">''Uncrowned'', chapter 21</ref> Additionally, the Frozen Blade team utilizes constructs capable of detecting [[Lindon's construct]] signature.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c13">''Uncrowned'', chapter 13</ref>}}
